# Theme country scope. Holds senate seats: chartered city (2), exarchate (1), despotate (1).
oe_tsn_seated = { OR = { oe_ts_charter = yes oe_ts_exarch = yes oe_ts_despot = yes } }
# BYZ/ROM scope. WP11-5 4-Prefecture Senate Delegation Cap active (max 4 seats/prefecture = 16 provincial seats vs 11 court seats).
oe_tsn_delegation_mode = {
    OR = {
        oe_prf_has_active_prefecture = yes
        oe_tsn_raw_prov_seats > 12
    }
}
# BYZ/ROM scope. No vote is pending (requests made meanwhile are queued).
oe_tsn_idle = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tsn_pending } }
# BYZ/ROM scope. The vote in progress passed: more seats for than against, or no seats at all.
oe_tsn_passed = {
    has_variable = oe_tsn_yes
    has_variable = oe_tsn_no
    OR = {
        var:oe_tsn_yes > var:oe_tsn_no
        AND = { var:oe_tsn_yes = 0 var:oe_tsn_no = 0 }
    }
}
# BYZ/ROM scope. The levy may be requested now.
oe_tsn_levy_allowed = {
    custom_tooltip = { text = oe_tsn_allow_auth trigger_if = { limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 2 } } trigger_else = { always = no } }
    custom_tooltip = { text = oe_tsn_allow_cd NOT = { has_variable = oe_tsn_levy_cd } }
    custom_tooltip = { text = oe_tsn_allow_active NOT = { has_variable = oe_ts_levy_extra } }
    custom_tooltip = { text = oe_tsn_allow_idle oe_tsn_idle = yes }
